INVALID_URL: The URL was not recognized as a supported Douyin or TikTok link.
UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT: That content type is not supported yet.
INVALID_PARAM: One or more request parameters are invalid.
UNAUTHENTICATED: A valid API key is required; send it in the X-API-Key header.
FORBIDDEN_SCOPE: This API key lacks the scope required by this endpoint.
NOT_FOUND: The requested resource does not exist.
CONTENT_PRIVATE: This content is private or has been removed by its author.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests; retry in {retry_after} seconds.
IDENTITY_POOL_EXHAUSTED: No identity is available; the pool is expected to recover in {retry_after} seconds.
ENDPOINT_CIRCUIT_OPEN: This endpoint is paused after repeated failures; it will be retried in {retry_after} seconds.
UPSTREAM_RISK_CONTROL: The platform flagged the request as automated traffic; the identity has been cooled down.
UPSTREAM_CHANGED: The platform response no longer matches the expected structure at {path}; please report this.
SIGNING_FAILED: Request signing failed; the signing algorithm may be out of date.
TASK_NOT_FOUND: No task exists with that id, or its result has already expired.
SETUP_ALREADY_DONE: Setup has already been completed on this instance.
SETUP_TOKEN_INVALID: The setup token is invalid or has expired.
INTERNAL: An unexpected internal error occurred; check the server logs for details.
